name: Stephen Michael Donnelly

I’m Stephen Donnelly, a senior research technician and independent consultant in community health research in San Francisco. I’ve spent much of my working life in practical lab work, training, and neighborhood health projects. My top ten interests are: community health; cooking vegetarian food; gardening; public-health and science writing; mentoring junior technicians; local lectures and policy discussions; practical repairs and tinkering; short bike rides around the city; strategy and puzzle games; and folk music and documentaries.

My propensity to purchase bottled gazpacho is **3 out of 5**. I might buy it, especially when I need a convenient meal, but I usually prefer making soup at home. I’d want to check the ingredient list, price, and freshness before deciding.
